title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：stamp　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stamp 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the postman ① collected the stamp that no sender in the office would have noted, and he said the collecting was the whole of the week. The ② stamp, meaning the mark itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; a stamp, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ stamp in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ stamp at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A stamp, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the postman said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stamp was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the mark. The ⑥ stamp, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; stamp, he said, is either something you collect or the only word that means both a mark and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ stamp had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ stamp of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of noting; stamp, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stamp I remember is the mark noted in the list, which closed in 1998 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ stamp, my mother said in 2000, is the only mark that improves by being noted; every stamp, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a mark. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 邮票（指邮局里每一枚旁边的那一枚）
B. n. 邮票（指那枚邮票本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：collect the stamp 集这一枚邮票
D. n. 邮票（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 邮票之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的邮票之事）
F. n. 邮票（指收发清单里写到、被记下的那一枚）
G. n. 邮票、念想（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 念想（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: collected the stamp that no sender in the office would have noted

the stamp at the far box

answers.why: collect the stamp 意为“集这一枚邮票”，1991 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯记下的一枚邮票做了一遍。
stamp 意为“邮票”，指那枚邮票本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
stamp 意为“邮票”，指邮局里每一枚旁边的那一枚，每一枚旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
stamp 意为“邮票”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stamp 意为“邮票、念想”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这枚念想就是那件事的全部。
stamp 意为“念想”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那枚邮票，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stamp 意为“邮票”，指收发清单里写到、被记下的那一枚，到 1996 年这一枚成了收发清单里的一行。
stamp 意为“邮票之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的邮票之事是一处邮局和三个星期的记下。
stamp 意为“邮票”，我记得的是收发清单里记下过的那一枚，1998 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一枚。
stamp 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，邮票是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的邮票。
